lay_text: No, I don't feel sick with it, and I haven't vomited.
No, I haven't had any fever.

I used to take metformin for my sugar, but I stopped it about two months ago.
I take a thyroid tablet every day. My thyroid is under control.
Oh, yes. I was taking some herbal capsules for my sugar that I bought on the internet. I took them for about a month and a half, and I stopped before I came into hospital.
They were Ayurvedic capsules for diabetes. I ordered them online. I took them for about six weeks and stopped before I came in.
